fieldValues.title: SRS implementation
fieldValues.purpose: One implementation of every capability, in the core service, exposed through CLI, WASM and MCP, that a third party can trust to behave as the spec says.
fieldValues.inside: srs-rust: srs-core, srs-repository and the adapters (CLI, bindings, MCP), and the mirror syncs that follow a spec release.
fieldValues.authority_basis: ADR-048 (implementation decision rules), capability-layering.md, and the SRS standard's compass, which it inherits on the OPERATION plane.
fieldValues.revision_condition: ADR-048 is amended, or the SRS standard changes a ruling the implementation executes.
